routes.name: Visa-free visit (exempt nationalities)
routes.summary: Many nationalities can enter Colombia without a visa as a visitor. The official exempt-country list is in Resolucion 5488 of 2022 and later updates. Check your passport against it.

other: Exact days and country list not confirmed from an official page this pass. Check Resolucion 5488 de 2022 and Migracion Colombia.

routes.name: Visa V Tourism
routes.summary: Tourist visitor visa for people who need a visa. Valid up to 1 year. Stays of up to 90 days, extendable by 90. No work.

routes.name: Visa V Business
routes.summary: Business visitor visa, valid up to 2 years. Up to 180 days per 365. No work and no social security.

routes.name: Visa V Airport transit
routes.summary: Airport transit visa for people who need one. Up to 24 hours in the airport, no entry into the country. Valid up to 30 days for multiple transits.

other: Which nationalities need it was not confirmed here.

stay.note: Max 24 hours in the airport, no entry (Art. 33)

routes.name: Visa V Digital Nomad (Nomada digital)
routes.summary: Two-year visa for remote workers paid from outside Colombia. You can't take paid work for Colombian entities.

other: Income of 3 SMLMV (Colombian monthly minimum wages), shown for the last 3 months
COP amount changes yearly, check the current minimum wage

routes.name: Visa V Rentista (passive income)
routes.summary: Two-year visa for people with steady passive income. No work.

other: Income of at least 10 SMLMV (Colombian monthly minimum wages)

stay.note: Art. 56. Moved from M to V in 2022.

routes.name: Visa V Student
routes.summary: Student visa valid up to 2 years. Postgraduate students may work up to 20 hours a week.

other: Admission and funds requirements not confirmed from an official page.

routes.name: Visa V Vacation and Work (working holiday)
routes.summary: One-year working holiday for ages 18 to 30. Granted once. Average bank balance above 5 SMLMV over 3 months.

Average bank balance above 5 SMLMV over 3 months

routes.name: Visa V Service, works or labor provider

routes.name: Visa V Seasonal agricultural worker

routes.summary: Visa for medical treatment. Valid 1 year, not extendable, max 180 days. No work.

routes.name: Naturalization (nationality by adoption)
routes.summary: Continuous residence counted from your resident visa issue date. Latin American or Caribbean natives: 1 year. Spanish natives: 2 years. Others: 5 years, or 2 years if married to a Colombian, a permanent partner, or with Colombian children. You need a knowledge test of the Constitution, history, geography and Spanish. Exempt: Colombian degree holders, over 65, and Spanish speakers skip the Spanish part. An absence of 1 year or more breaks continuity.

eligibility.language: Spanish plus basic knowledge test (Constitution, history, geography)
other: Must hold a resident visa
